nodes.label: Zod Content Validation
nodes.rationale: A shared schema validates content for both the CLI and terminal generator so invalid entries fail before they are written or built.

nodes.label: Create-and-publish-only Generator
nodes.rationale: Editing existing content is kept outside the generator as a deliberate action through the CLI or direct Markdown editing.

nodes.label: Build-time Content Delivery
nodes.rationale: The production site consumes repository content at build time, so published changes require a new build and deployment.

nodes.label: Trusted Markdown Rendering
nodes.rationale: HTML is rendered as authored, so Markdown changes are restricted to trusted contributors.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Consistency for Orders
nodes.author: Md Mehedi Hasan
nodes.rationale: Relational consistency guarantees are valuable for order data, while indexes support frequently queried columns.

nodes.label: API-boundary Caching
nodes.author: Md Mehedi Hasan
nodes.rationale: Product listings can be cached aggressively, but caching at the API boundary avoids embedding cache concerns inside business logic.

nodes.label: Evolutionary Service Decomposition
nodes.author: Md Mehedi Hasan
nodes.rationale: Start with a monolith and split focused services only after measured traffic or operational pain justifies the added complexity.

nodes.label: Consistent Visual Scale
nodes.author: Md Mehedi Hasan
nodes.rationale: A small typography set and a repeated spacing scale create elegance through consistency and restraint.

nodes.label: Build-time Rendering
nodes.author: Md Mehedi Hasan
nodes.rationale: Pages that can be rendered at build time should be, because static output gives users faster page loads.

nodes.label: Workers Runtime Parity
nodes.author: Md Mehedi Hasan
nodes.rationale: The plugin makes local development behave more like the production Workers runtime, reducing deployment-only incompatibilities.

nodes.label: Signing Secret Protection
nodes.author: Md Mehedi Hasan
nodes.rationale: Keystores and password-bearing properties must be backed up safely and excluded from version control.

nodes.label: TestFlight Validation
nodes.author: Md Mehedi Hasan
nodes.rationale: TestFlight provides the final pre-review checkpoint using the exact binary that users will download.

nodes.label: End-to-end Feature Ownership
nodes.rationale: Owning work from requirements through production encourages earlier attention to edge cases and failure modes.

nodes.label: Protected Health Information Security
nodes.rationale: Patient data requirements made auditing, encryption, and secure token handling necessary for every API interaction.

nodes.label: Query Indexing and Pagination
nodes.rationale: Large patient datasets made naive queries unusable, requiring indexes and pagination for acceptable performance.

nodes.label: Reversible Healthcare Deployment
nodes.rationale: Daily clinical dependence on the system requires deployments to be smooth and reversible.
